published_prior_art.cite: AhnKasahara2026 identifies only the regular ID stratum; Critch2013 treats a single binary HMM rather than a coupled-arm causal fiber.
BeresteanuMolinari2008 supplies general random-set asymptotics, not a cross-arm alignment stratum with disconnected ATT image.
GuptaKumarVassilvitskii2016 concerns recovery of separated Markov mixtures, not pair-marginal insufficiency for a coupled-arm ATT fiber.
Critch2013 gives single-HMM semialgebraic membership; no cited result classifies this coupled-arm one-collision causal subfiber.
Critch2013 and DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024 do not give a finite observable singleton certificate for all exceptional transition-alignment charts.
AhnKasahara2026 establishes regular point identification but not an observable necessary-and-sufficient ATT-constancy criterion on singular fibers.
DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024 gives general numerical sharp bounding and epsilon-sharpness, not this model-specific exact component-and-witness algorithm.
AhnKasahara2026 supplies no full sharp ATT-region calculation for the displayed singular law.
AhnKasahara2026 Proposition 4, Proposition 5, and Corollary 1 already establish the regular parameter, LTATT, and aggregate-ATT identification reduction.
RomanoShaikh2010 and ChenChristensenTamer2018 provide general identified-set coverage frameworks; the proposed multinomial inversion is a specialized implementation.
BeresteanuMolinari2008 gives general partially identified-set consistency theory; the branch-persistence characterization is the proposed model-specific addition.

soundness_flags.label: ass:eta-domain
soundness_flags.one_line: AhnKasahara2026 supports conditional treatment overlap, not the proposal's stronger uniform compact box placing every mixing, assignment, and transition primitive in [eta,1-eta].

accepted_scope_caveats.label: ass:branch-continuity / thm:hausdorff-consistency
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Hausdorff and ordered-endpoint consistency are conditional on BC(P), rather than claimed through branch mergers or component contacts.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The consistency claim is restricted to P in M_eta^bc; outside that class the proposal claims only the stated failure/outer-excess distinction.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 15--17, Assumptions TI-LT, CS-LT, RSM, M; Proposition 4; Proposition 5 and Corollary 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: CS-LT bounds Pr(D=1 | untreated history,Z) away from zero and one, while RSM and M state the mixture/Markov model; Proposition 4 is regular identification and Proposition 5 plus Corollary 1 identify LTATT and ATT under TI-LT.

source_verification_receipts.version: January 19, 2023 author PDF corresponding to Journal of Econometrics 237, 105462
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Under Assumptions 1--3, initial-condition distributions, transition kernels, and type probabilities are identified up to a common permutation from four consecutive observations.
The paper supplies a birational parametrization, explicit inverse, and semialgebraic membership test for binary HMMs; vanishing denominators route membership to lower-dimensional submodels.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 119(547), 2024
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The method reduces discrete causal questions to polynomial programs and uses dual relaxation plus spatial branch-and-bound, returning continually refined containing ranges and an epsilon-sharpness guarantee when incomplete.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag ass:eta-domain as a proposal-specific compact-interior regularity condition, or cite a source that actually assumes uniform lower and upper bounds for every primitive; explain why this restriction is needed for exact chart certification rather than presenting it as Ahn--Kasahara's common-support condition.

Add a short theorem or corollary that explicitly proves a nonempty relatively open singular stratum with disconnected ATT image and supplies a symbolic witness family, linking the atlas to an applied sign-reversal consequence rather than only to computation.

For AtlasATT, state an explicit input encoding and a bit-complexity or chart-count bound for the fixed binary model; this would sharpen the distinction from generic polynomial optimization and quantifier elimination.

recommended_next_step: Revise the compact-positivity assumption's standardness tag and justification, retain BC as an explicit conditional inference scope, then advance the field-tier atlas kernel to Stage 0.
